unit: Geometry · Chapter III. Coordinates in space

stages.headline: A motion is a mapping of space (or the plane) that keeps distances: A'B' = AB.
stages.headlineEnglish: A motion is a mapping of space (or the plane) that keeps distances: A'B' = AB.

stages.headline: Motions include central, axial and mirror symmetries, translations and rotations.
stages.headlineEnglish: Motions include central, axial and mirror symmetries, translations and rotations.

stages.headline: A motion maps a figure to an equal figure; two figures are equal if a motion maps one onto the other.
stages.headlineEnglish: A motion maps a figure to an equal figure; two figures are equal if a motion maps one onto the other.
